title: No significant pairwise correlations with performance_rating
summary: Pearson and Spearman correlations between all numeric features and performance_rating are weak. No feature exceeds |r| > 0.1 at p < 0.05.

title: performance_rating distribution assessment
summary: performance_rating has mean=50.0, std=10.0. Distribution shows some departure from normality (Shapiro-Wilk rejects at p<0.05). 2 outliers beyond 3 SD.

title: salary_band shows no ordinal proxy behaviour
summary: Kruskal-Wallis test: performance_rating does not differ across salary bands (H=3.96, p=0.412). No feature shows a significant monotonic trend across bands.

title: Predictors are not multicollinear
summary: All VIFs are below 5 (years_experience=1.01, training_hours=1.01, team_size=1.01, projects_completed=1.0, satisfaction_score=1.0, commute_minutes=1.01, remote_pct=1.01). No pairwise correlation(s) exceed |r| > 0.7.

title: OLS model does not exceed chance performance
summary: Observed R²=0.0098 vs permuted null mean=0.0091. Empirical p=0.380. The model does not exceed chance at the 0.05 level.
